rationale: Pinned Aider EditBlockCoder.apply_edits redirects a failed nonempty anchor to the first matching in-chat file; real writes preserve successful earlier blocks before later failure. Its dry-run resolves paths before prepare_to_edit permission handling, so this is not a permission-bypass claim. Exact/indent/blank/ellipsis matching and newline normalization reduce model bookkeeping but differ from Devtools exact unique observed/current atomic admission. No same-model efficacy evidence or format adoption follows; keep source authority, limits, bytes and all-or-nothing semantics.
duplicate_disposition: Existing qualified proposal owns the pressure; preserve its payload, parent and state. Source/test research only: no new B-number, approval, grant, inference or implementation.
